page.description: Generate a routed page (*.page.ts) under src/app/pages, wrapping @schematics/angular:component with type=page.

model.description: Generate a shared model interface under src/app/shared/models/model.

dto.description: Generate a response DTO interface under src/app/shared/models/dto/response.

mapper.description: Generate a DTO-to-model mapper class under src/app/shared/mappers.

helper.description: Generate a helper class under src/app/shared/helpers.

service.description: Generate a plain (non-api) service class under src/app/shared/helpers/service.

api.description: Generate a HTTP api class under src/app/pages/<name>/data/state.

store.description: Generate a signal store under src/app/pages/<name>/data/state.

facade.description: Generate a facade class under src/app/pages/<name>/data/state.
